items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated remote attackers to switch customer sessions and escalate privileges. Exploitation attempts have been detected in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) could lead to arbitrary code execution and requires authentication but not administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 7.7) could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.6) affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) could enable a security-feature bypass and requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 6.5) could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 2.7) could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution Vulnerability
items.summary: A critical vulnerability addressed in APSB26-73 allows for unauthenticated arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVSS 8.6) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass security features.

items.title: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities in Amasty Magento Extensions
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for dozens of its Magento extensions, addressing two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated arbitrary file upload vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento 2 allows attackers to write executable files to the store's media directory, leading to remote code execution. Exploitation attempts were observed shortly after disclosure.

items.title: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
items.summary: A moderate-severity vulnerability (CVSS 4.3) allows for URL redirection to untrusted sites, potentially used in phishing attacks.

items.title: Information Exposure Vulnerability
items.summary: A moderate-severity information exposure vulnerability (CVSS 3.7) could leak sensitive system information to unauthenticated visitors, aiding further attacks.
